thread:
jin: hitting a bizarre edge during embed onboarding. using the new batch helper => backend returns correct count but one vector has wrong length (1539) while model is 1536.
priya: yikes. which language + sdk?
jin: go-sdk v0.7.1, sampleapp-go v0.2.0. happens only when HTTP_PROXY is set and we have a retry. curl straight to prod is clean.
alex: proxy + retry smells like header/body rewrite bug. can you paste the minimal repro?
jin: sure. call is standard:
```go
client.Embeddings.Create(ctx, EmbeddingRequest{Model: "openembed-1536", Input: []string{"p1","p2","p3"}, BatchSize: 3})
```
response snippet: 
```
{"data":[{"embedding":[...1536 floats...]},{"embedding":[...1539 floats...]},{"embedding":[...1536 floats...]}]}
```
jin: digging into client, our batch helper uses bytes.Buffer to join frames, then encodes floats into binary and writes into buffer. on retry path the buffer is reused and we append into it without truncating. interestingly only one item gains extra 3 floats.
priya: 3 extra floats -> probably three bytes of corrupt header decoded as floats? or misaligned float32 parse. any logs for the retry?
jin: yes:
```
[09:12:02] batch send id=b_77 size=3
[09:12:02] server 429 rate_limited
[09:12:02] sdk retry -> wait 500ms
[09:12:02] replaying batch b_77 (reuse buffer=true)
[09:12:03] server 200 OK
```
alex: reuse buffer=true is the suspect. code should Reset() before re-encoding.
priya: beyond the SDK bug, backend should validate per-model dim and reject mismatches. otherwise downstream rerank or semantic search silently breaks.
dev-bot: reproducer CI test template created at tests/embeddings/retry_buffer_reuse_test.go
jin: i ran a local repro toggling HTTP_PROXY to a mitm proxy and confirmed replay path appends previous garbage; patch below fixed it quickly:
```diff
- buf := bytes.NewBuffer(existing)
- // append new items
+ buf := bytes.NewBuffer(nil)
+ // write new items (don't reuse existing buffer)
```
priya: please open SDK PR and include a unit test for retry+proxy+gzip combinations (we've seen gzip double-compress elsewhere).
alex: temporary guard: backend dim-check and reject (400) and log request id + model for quick triage. add a webhook to notify eng-sre when we see dimension rejections > 0.
ci-bot: created ticket INF-2333 for go-sdk buffer reuse and INF-2334 for server-side dim guard, linked to pipelines #856 #857.
priya: also add a short note in sampleapp README about toggling HTTP_PROXY when debugging weird embed shapes. new hires hit this during onboarding and it creates a lot of confusion.
jin: filed PR for SDK fix + tests, will ping reviewers @alex @priya. thanks all.
